name: $loc:activity.install-monitoring
note: The cheapest purchase in the game. Without it you cannot see condition, so you cannot service. RATE, not price (finding 289): $0.00869565M and 0.0434783 turns per element, derived from the measured $0.2M/1t on the DEVELOPED fixture chain - six wells, their gathering lines and the full train, twenty-three elements - because that is the plant repairs were measured on; a young field's small chain is cheaper to keep.
